title: DLAMA: A Framework for Curating Culturally Diverse Facts for Probing the Knowledge of Pretrained Language Models
reasoning: The paper specifically benchmarks religious knowledge through the P140 (religion or worldview) predicate. It includes a qualitative analysis of religious bias (Section 3.2), a detailed figure showing the distribution of predictions for religious affiliations across 20 languages (Figure 1), and includes religious triples as a core component of the DLAMA-v1 benchmark.
